en.headline: Kai Tak Hospital family clinic opens as patients arrive
en.dek: The family medicine centre began service on Monday with about 350 appointments a day, and staff were helping people register after 8:30am.
body: Kai Tak Hospital began phased services on Monday, with the Family Medicine Integrated Centre on the first floor of the specialist outpatient block taking its first patients.

RTHK reported that staff were on hand to help people register after 8:30am. The centre is starting with about 350 family-medicine appointments a day. Kowloon Central Cluster chief executive and hospital chief executive Cheung Fuk-chi said on Sunday that the opening quota would stay limited until the hospital was satisfied the workflow was safe and smooth, and that more slots would be added later.

The Hospital Authority has said specialist outpatient services from Queen Elizabeth Hospital, including medicine, surgery, neurosurgery and clinical oncology, will move over in batches from late October. Inpatient care, surgery and the accident and emergency department are not part of this phase; the authority has said those major clinical services are planned for 2028.

Patients who had booked told RTHK that several bus and minibus routes reach the hospital, and that one journey from the Kai Tak station public-transport interchange took a little over 10 minutes to the lobby. The authority has said appointments for episodic illness can be made through the HA Go app or the telephone booking system.

zh.headline: 啟德醫院家庭醫學中心今早投入服務
zh.dek: 專科門診大樓一樓的家庭醫學綜合中心星期一開始應診，初期每日約350個名額，早上八時半後已有市民到場登記。
body: 啟德醫院星期一開始分階段投入服務，位於專科門診大樓一樓的家庭醫學綜合中心率先應診。
港台報道，早上八時半後陸續有已預約的市民到場登記，職員在旁協助。中心初期每日提供約350個家庭醫學診所名額。九龍中醫院聯網總監、啟德醫院行政總監張復熾星期日表示，名額要視乎運作是否安全順暢，因此開院初期供應有限，日後會陸續增加。
醫管局早前表示，伊利沙伯醫院的內科、外科、神經外科及臨床腫瘤科專科門診，將由十月下旬起分批遷入。住院、手術及急症室不在這一階段；局方說主要臨床服務計劃於2028年展開。
已預約的市民向港台表示，多條巴士及小巴路線可達醫院，由啟德站公共運輸交匯處乘巴士到大堂外約十多分鐘。偶發性疾病病人可經「HA Go」或電話預約系統預約。
